mapper.sql: select id, approval_instance_id, process_instance_id, flowable_task_id, task_definition_key, task_name, assignee_user_id, original_assignee_user_id, owner_user_id, task_status, delegated_to_user_id, parent_task_id, due_at, created_at, completed_at from wf_approval_task
mapper.select: where approval_instance_id = #{approvalInstanceId} order by created_at desc
where assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId} and task_status in ('CREATED', 'PENDING') order by created_at desc
where assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId} and task_status in ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') order by completed_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into wf_approval_task (id, approval_instance_id, process_instance_id, flowable_task_id, task_definition_key, task_name, assignee_user_id, original_assignee_user_id, owner_user_id, task_status, delegated_to_user_id, parent_task_id, due_at, created_at, completed_at) values (#{id}, #{approvalInstanceId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{flowableTaskId}, #{taskDefinitionKey}, #{taskName}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{originalAssigneeUserId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{taskStatus}, #{delegatedToUserId}, #{parentTaskId}, #{dueAt}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt})
